resourceControls: bounded allocation with long comments and system identifiers

contract: One declaration-only DOCTYPE before the root: bare, SYSTEM or PUBLIC. External identifiers are inert; no external resolution, entity expansion, default attributes, internal subsets (even empty) or duplicate declarations. XML readers keep original input bytes and BCL encoding interpretation. Other malformed XML remains MalformedInput. Root parsing, font discovery and output-scale probing share the policy.
resources: Fixed 32 KiB additional prolog allowance, released before the main reader is constructed; ordinary reader allowance remains reserved by its caller. Guard traversals charge caller work and check cancellation every 4096 encoded bytes or decoded characters. No DOM or whole-input string; root/discovery borrow their work counter, and the existing output-scale probe uses its separately bounded probe counter.

controls.pixelClaims: Positive synthetic controls compare exact PNG bytes with an independently established solid-red control; no newly admitted corporate document is claimed exact.
